newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SingTel says to spend S$131 mln on pagers.
newsitem.headline: SingTel says to spend S$131 mln on pagers.

text.p: Singapore Telecom (SingTel) said on Friday it will spend S$131 million over the next five years on upgrading its paging network.
The company's President and Chief Executive Officer Lee Hsien Yang told a news conference that the company had so far invested S$84 million on its paging network.
"We will be spending another S$131 million in the next five years to improve and upgrade it further," he said.
Lee said the company would extend its paging services to include a new roaming service for SingTel subscribers travelling to Thailand and also introduce an Internet paging service.
"Subscribers to the Internet paging service will be able to receive a page from those who are surfing the Net whether in Singapore or overseas."

"These value-added services, which will be launched by the end of this month, will greatly enhance the mobility and efficiency as well as the usefulness (of the pagers) to our business customers," Lee said.
